title: JAX Summer Student Program 2027
about: The Jackson Laboratory's Summer Student Program is a 10-week research program at Bar Harbor (residential) or Farmington. Applications for 2027 open in November and are due January 25, 2027, at 5:00 p.m. ET.
requirements: Applications must be formally submitted in the portal by the deadline; edits allowed until then
Acceptance notifications by email by March 31
10-week program at Bar Harbor (residential) or Farmington (non-residential)
card_alt: Card for the JAX Summer Student Program 2027, an internship at The Jackson Laboratory (JAX) in the United States, with an application deadline of 25 Jan 2027. The photo shows the Statue of Liberty in front of the Manhattan skyline and the Empire State Building in New York.
